title: Smurfit Westrock Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Smurfit Westrock Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
body_markdown:
Smurfit Westrock plc (NYSE: SW) today announced the financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Key Points:**


- Net Sales of $8,161 million
- Net Income of $219 million, with a Net Income Margin of 2.7%
- Adjusted EBITDA of $1,205 million, with an Adjusted EBITDA Margin1 of 14.8%
- Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities of $874 million
- Quarterly dividend of $0.4523 per ordinary share


Smurfit Westrock plc’s performance for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 (in millions, except margins and per share data):


Tony Smurfit, President and CEO, commented:


“Set against unprecedented cost inflation and somewhat weaker than anticipated converting volumes, our third quarter performance of Adjusted EBITDA¹ of $1,205 million with an Adjusted EBITDA Margin¹ of 14.8% represents a resilient performance. Across all our regions we continue to make good progress in implementing our owner operator model and developing our innovative packaging approach for our customers. We have also implemented significant pricing initiatives across most paper grades and we expect these should more than offset input costs as these increases are passed through.


“Our North American business continues to make good progress. The region reported Adjusted EBITDA of $760 million and an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 15.6% for the third quarter. We remain sold out in all containerboard grades, and most consumer grades, and our converting businesses in both business areas continue to improve. Our focus on quality and service, as well as investment in productivity and efficiency, is winning customers and has established a strong foundation for future performance. In both Corrugated and Consumer, we continue to see a reduction in loss makers and are optimizing our businesses to improve returns. Most importantly, I am particularly impressed with the expertise and commitment of our people that are leading the change towards a customer centric, performance-led culture.


“Our EMEA & APAC business continues to outperform in a market that is heavily impacted by rising energy costs. The region reported Adjusted EBITDA of $379 million and an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 13.4% for the third quarter. Containerboard price increases to offset costs have been implemented and are being passed on with the normal time lag. Our EMEA & APAC business is increasingly seen as the partner of choice due to our unrivalled product portfolio and our leadership and investment in innovation, sustainability, quality and service.


“In our Latin American region, during the third quarter, we announced our agreement to acquire the containerboard assets of CMPC in Chile. This acquisition further strengthens our leadership presence in Latin America as the only pan regional supplier, where we continue to see many opportunities for development. For the quarter, the region reported Adjusted EBITDA of $126 million and an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 21.4%.


"For full year 2026, we now estimate our Adjusted EBITDA to be approximately $4.7 billion. This expected outcome primarily reflects the continued and unprecedented cost inflation we are experiencing. For example, for the full year 2026 we expect to absorb approximately $700 million of additional freight and energy costs alone, significantly more than anticipated. We have, and are, implementing price increases to more than offset these costs, the full benefits of which we expect to realize into 2027. Against what has been a challenging operating environment I am very proud of the efforts of all our people who have set the foundation for continued progress into 2027 and beyond.”


*1* *. Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA Margin and Adjusted Basic EPS are non-GAAP measures. See the “Non-GAAP Financial Measures and Reconciliations” below for discussion and reconciliation of these measures to the most comparable GAAP measures.*


*2.* *Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP financial measure. We have not reconciled Adjusted EBITDA outlook to the most comparable GAAP outlook because it is not possible to do so without unreasonable efforts due to the uncertainty and potential variability of reconciling items, which are dependent on future events and often outside of management’s control and which could be significant. Because such items cannot be reasonably predicted with the level of precision required, we are unable to provide an outlook for the comparable GAAP measure (net income).*

#### Dividend


Smurfit Westrock plc announced today that its Board approved a quarterly dividend of $0.4523 per share on its ordinary shares. The quarterly dividend of $0.4523 per ordinary share is payable on December 10, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 13, 2026.


#### Earnings Call


Management will host an earnings conference call today at 7:30 AM ET / 11:30 AM GMT to discuss Smurfit Westrock’s financial results. The conference call will be accessible through a live webcast. Interested investors and other individuals can access the webcast, earnings release, and earnings presentation via the Company’s website at www.smurfitwestrock.com. The webcast will be available at[https://investors.smurfitwestrock.com/overview](https://investors.smurfitwestrock.com/overview) and a replay of the webcast will be available on the website shortly after the call.
